_comment: builtby.win/dotfiles — managed by chezmoi. Add personal modifications to complex_modifications.rules array. Chezmoi preserves local changes (--keep).

rules.description: MacBook: F1-F7 raw, Fn/Ctrl = system shortcuts; F8-F12 media, Fn/Ctrl = raw F-keys
Neru chords: fj terminal grid / app hints, dk scroll, df hints, jl recursive_grid
jk chord: window leader (Hyper+F13, handled by Hammerspoon leader module)
Caps Lock is Escape when tapped and Control when held
Fn exposes raw function keys and taps as Control
One-shot modifiers with Microsoft Sculpt layout parity
Right Option and Sculpt Menu: tap for next-key Hyper, hold for Hyper
Control + n/p and h/j/k/l are arrow keys
MapleStory Classic World: F1-F12 send as standard function keys
